description: This script automates code generation tasks for the ANGLE project, specifically generating build files and data dependencies for Vulkan conformance test suite (VK-GL-CTS). It manages data directories, path replacements, and creates build configuration files (.gn and .gni) based on the source directory structure.

methods.name: initDataDirectories
methods.description: Initializes a list of data directories with specific subpaths related to GLES and external data sources.

methods.name: initPathReplacements
methods.description: Sets up path replacements for external data directories to adjust file paths during code generation.

methods.name: createBuildGnFile
methods.description: Creates or overwrites a build.gn file at the specified path.

methods.name: createGniFile
methods.description: Creates or overwrites a .gni file at the specified path.

methods.name: writeFileHeader
methods.description: Writes a standard header comment to a file, indicating it is auto-generated.

methods.name: fixDestinationDirectory
methods.description: Replaces parts of a directory path based on path replacements.

methods.name: convertPathToVarName
methods.description: Converts a filesystem path to a variable name by replacing path separators with underscores.

methods.name: getCMakeLists
methods.description: Recursively searches for CMakeLists.txt files within a directory tree.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function handling command-line arguments, directory traversal, and generation of build and data dependency files for the VK-GL-CTS project.
